reason: It reads well, but I have never heard of REPAIHUB and nobody in my family or community groups has used it. I don't move lakhs on the strength of an ad; I would wait until someone I know vouches for it.
objection: What if the transfer gets stuck halfway or the CA rejects something? The refund of their fee is nice, but my money would still be sitting in limbo in India with nobody I know to call.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three people in my community WhatsApp group saying they moved ten lakh or more through them and the money arrived on time.
